verdict.rationale: Gusto publishes an official GitHub repo, Gusto/gusto-cli, described as an "Agent-friendly developer interface for Gusto payroll." Its README shows concrete commands for auth, employees, pay schedules and skill installation, which directly delivers an official CLI aimed at AI-native use. The evidence is a single README summary, though. missing for 10: in-depth first-party CLI documentation (command reference, install and auth details, scope of coverage), maturity or stability information, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
